integrity: The analytical proof supplies all-metric coverage; accompanying finite checker is supplementary, not a proof of infinite quantifiers. Source definitions were compared with publicly available primary full text.
scientific_limitations: Only n=3 and n=4; worst-case constants are sharp suprema, not necessarily attained. Efficiency bound applies to arbitrary metric spaces; no all-metric strategyproofness claim. Full novelty relative to all possible sources and independent scientific validation are not established.
title: Sharp three- and four-agent approximation ratios for distance-proportional two-facility sampling
